Package core

Class Desktop

  • java.lang.Object
    • core.Computer
      • core.Desktop
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Comparable<Computer>, java.lang.Iterable<java.lang.String>
    public class Desktop
extends Computer
    The java.Desktop class represents a desktop computer and extends the java.Computer class. It introduces a unique property, formFactor, to describe the type of the desktop's case.

    This class inherits common properties from the java.Computer class and adds functionality specific to desktops.
